ProgramUnit.Name: DOWNLOAD_AS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION DOWNLOAD_AS(download_fname IN VARCHAR2, download_dir IN VARCHAR2) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 l_success BOOLEAN;
 --client_directory VARCHAR2(100) := 'C:\LT_ServerData';
 --client_directory VARCHAR2(100) := 'D:\lifetrak\replication';
 client_fname VARCHAR2(512);
 client_fsep VARCHAR2(1);
 sep VARCHAR2(1 CHAR);
 download_bare_fname VARCHAR2(50);
 l_status VARCHAR2(1000);
BEGIN
 client_fsep := webutil_clientinfo.get_file_separator;
 sep := WebUtil_Core.getServerFileSep;
 download_bare_fname := substr(download_fname,instr(download_fname,sep,-1)+1); 
 client_fname := download_dir || client_fsep || download_bare_fname; 
 l_success := webutil_file_transfer.AS_to_Client_with_progress
 (clientFile => client_fname
 ,serverFile => download_fname
 ,progressTitle => 'Title'
 ,progressSubTitle => 'SubTitle'
 );
 if l_success
 then
 -- message('File downloaded successfully from the Application Server');
 return true;
 else
 --message('File download from Application Server failed');
 return false;
 end if;
 
 exception
 when others
 then
 l_status := 'File - ' || download_fname ||' - Download Failed: ' || substr(sqlerrm,75);
 log_error('LTAPI', 'MOBILE PC DOWNLOAD', l_status);
 return false;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: UPLOAD_AS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION UPLOAD_AS(upload_filename IN VARCHAR2) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 l_success BOOLEAN;
 upload_bare_filename VARCHAR2(50);
 m_workarea VARCHAR2(512);
 sep VARCHAR2(1 CHAR) := WebUtil_Core.getServerFileSep;
 client_file_sep VARCHAR2(1 CHAR) := webutil_clientinfo.get_file_separator;
 server_filename VARCHAR2(512);
BEGIN
 m_workarea := WebUtil_Core.ReadFromPropertyBundle('transfer.appsrv.workAreaRoot');
 --l_bare_filename := substr(upload_filename,instr(upload_filename,'\',-1)+1);
 --server_filename := m_workarea || sep || WebUtil_Core.getClientUserName || sep || l_bare_filename; 
 upload_bare_filename := substr(upload_filename,instr(upload_filename,client_file_sep,-1)+1); 
 server_filename := m_workarea || sep || upload_bare_filename; 
 
 l_success := webutil_file_transfer.Client_To_AS
 (clientFile => upload_filename -- 'C:\LTExtract\temp.txt';
 ,serverFile => server_filename --'/tmp/webutil/upload.dmp'--d:\temp\'||l_bare_filename
 ,asynchronous => false
 ,callbackTrigger => null
 ); 
 if l_success
 then
 --message('File uploaded successfully to the Application Server');
 return true;
 else
 --message('File upload to Application Server failed');
 return false;
 end if;
 
 exception
 when others
 then
 message('File upload failed: '||sqlerrm);pause;
 return false;
 

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: LOG_ERROR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE log_error(pl_src_id in varchar2, pl_data_src in varchar2, pl_log_text in varchar2) is
Begin
 insert into LT_DONOR_API_LOG(source_id,
 data_source_name,
 log_text,
 insert_date,
 program_id)
 values( pl_src_id,
 pl_data_src,
 pl_log_text,
 sysdate,
 'ONIMPCUD');
Exception 
 when others then
 message('Err : Inserting into log table ' || substr(sqlerrm,1,100));
END log_error;
